Before I sign, I'd like to hear a concise current-information update from each of you regarding the student's situation -- academic recovery steps, activity participation rules, health-office procedures, attendance records, family communication, or anything else relevant. Please go ahead in whatever order you'd like, and I'll make sure anyone who hasn't yet reported has a chance to speak before we settle the plan.
